name: Do not retrieve online tips in Settings
description: Configures the Group Policy 'Allow Online Tips' (Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > Control Panel) with online tips not allowed, by setting AllowOnlineTips = 0 (REG_DWORD) in HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer.
rationale: Settings no longer contacts Microsoft content services to download tips and help content, which removes promotional and suggested content from Settings and the network requests that fetch it.
effects: The Settings app does not retrieve online tips and help content from Microsoft content services.
sideEffects: Online help links and tips that Settings would download are not shown; local Settings functionality is unchanged.
Applies to every user account on the device.
notes: Policy definition ControlPanel.admx, policy AllowOnlineTips (class Machine): boolean element 'AllowOnlineTips', true = 1, false = 0. Policy CSP Settings/AllowOnlineTips documents 0 as 'Not allowed'.
Requires Administrator rights (the value is stored under HKLM).

references.title: Microsoft Learn - Policy CSP Settings: AllowOnlineTips (group policy mapping: ControlPanel.admx)
